CCSS-M.title: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics

HSA.REI.B.title: Solve equations and inequalities in one variable

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.HSA.REI.B.3.description: Solve linear equations and inequalities in one variable, including equations with coefficients represented by letters.

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.HSA.REI.B.4.description: Solve quadratic equations in one variable.

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.HSA.REI.B.4.B.description: Solve quadratic equations by inspection, taking square roots, completing the square, the quadratic formula and factoring, as appropriate to the initial form of the equation.

HSA.SSE.B.title: Write expressions in equivalent forms to solve problems

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.HSA.SSE.B.3.A.description: Factor a quadratic expression to reveal the zeros of the function it defines.

7.EE.B.title: Solve real-life and mathematical problems using numerical and algebraic expressions and equations

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.7.EE.B.4.description: Use variables to represent quantities in a real-world or mathematical problem, and construct simple equations and inequalities to solve problems by reasoning about the quantities.

CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.7.EE.B.4.A.description: Solve word problems leading to equations of the form px + q = r and p(x + q) = r.

TEKS.MATH.A1.8.A.description: Solve quadratic equations having real solutions by factoring, taking square roots, completing the square, and applying the quadratic formula.

TEKS.MATH.7.11.A.description: Model and solve one-variable, two-step equations and inequalities.

TEKS.MATH.8.8.C.description: Model and solve one-variable equations with variables on both sides of the equal sign.
